title: Attorney weighs in on Texas surrogacy dispute
script: This is World Pulse Daily with a quick news update. Reports are focusing on this development: Attorney weighs in on Texas surrogacy dispute. In simple words, A Texas judge is hearing arguments on who has the legal right to make medical decisions on behalf of a baby with a heart defect who was carried to term by a surrogate against the biological parents' wishes..
